versions.changelog:
- Added a Python wrapper script (`scripts/upload.py`) for uploading files, handling all curl invocation, JSON, and temp-file management.
- Updated documentation to require use of the wrapper script instead of manual curl commands or JSON payloads.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- Clarified and streamlined usage instructions and workflow in the docs.

- Changed the API base URL from `https://api.xiongan-company.com` to `https://dropfiles.tokendealhub.com`.
- Updated the upload instructions to emphasize that only `curl` should be used to send requests; all other HTTP clients (e.g. Python urllib, Node fetch) may be blocked by Cloudflare WAF.
- Added guidance for handling large or special-character content: write the JSON payload to a temporary file and use `curl -d @file` rather than inlining in the shell.
- Removed the old sample file `skill-card.md` and added a new `README.md`.
- Adjusted endpoint paths to align with the new service domain.

- Initial release of drop-files-skill.
- Allows uploading HTML or Markdown content to DropFiles and generates a public shareable link.
- Supports optional password protection (user-supplied or auto-generated 6-digit code).
- Handles content type detection, custom expiration time, and optional titles.
- Returns public URL (and preview URL) on success; surfaces helpful error messages and suggestions on failure.
